cases.sentence: Виночерпий и пекарь египетского царя провинились перед своим ___.
cases.translation: The cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before/against) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Начальник стражи поручил их ___, и тот прислуживал им.
cases.translation: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he served them.
cases.explain: The verb поручить (to assign to someone) takes its recipient in the dative case.

cases.translation: Do interpretations not belong to God?
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я видел во сне виноградную ___, и на лозе были три ветви.
cases.translation: In my dream I saw a grapevine, and on the vine were three branches.
cases.explain: The transitive verb видеть takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: У меня в ___ была чаша фараона.
cases.translation: In my hand was Pharaoh's cup.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я взял виноград, выжал сок в ___ и подал чашу в руку фараону.
cases.translation: I took the grapes, pressed the juice into the cup, and put the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Упомяни обо мне фараону, чтобы вызволить меня из ___.
cases.translation: Mention me to Pharaoh, so as to bring me out of the prison.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я держал на ___ три корзины с хлебом.
cases.translation: I was holding three baskets of bread on my head.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Фараон разгневался на двух своих приближенных, главного Виночерпия и главного пекаря, и заключил их в темницу при доме начальника стражи, туда же, куда был заключен Иосиф.
reading.question: With whom was Pharaoh angry?
options: His chief cup bearer and chief baker
reading.correct: His chief cup bearer and chief baker
reading.explain: The text says Pharaoh was angry 'на двух своих приближенных, главного Виночерпия и главного пекаря' (with his two officials, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker).

reading.ru: Иосиф сказал им, «Разве толкование не от Бога? Расскажите мне ваши сны».
reading.question: To whom did Joseph say interpretations belong?
reading.explain: Joseph asks 'Разве толкование не от Бога?' (Do interpretations not belong to God?).

reading.question: What did the three branches represent?
reading.explain: The text says 'Три ветви — это три дня' (The three branches are three days).

reading.ru: Через три дня фараон возвысит тебя и возвратит на прежнее место.
reading.question: What did Joseph tell the cup bearer would happen in three days?
options: Pharaoh would restore him to his former position
reading.correct: Pharaoh would restore him to his former position
reading.explain: The text says 'фараон возвысит тебя и возвратит на прежнее место' (Pharaoh will lift you up and restore you to your former place).

reading.ru: Я держал на голове три корзины с хлебом.
reading.question: What did the baker see in his dream?
options: Three baskets of bread on his head
reading.correct: Three baskets of bread on his head
reading.explain: The baker says 'Я держал на голове три корзины с хлебом' (I was holding three baskets of bread on my head).

reading.ru: Но главный виночерпий не вспомнил об Иосифе, он забыл о нем.
reading.question: What did the chief cup bearer do after his release?
reading.explain: The text says 'главный виночерпий не вспомнил об Иосифе, он забыл о нем' (the chief cup bearer did not remember Joseph, he forgot him).
